Lines of text do not follow straight horizontal baselines; they wave and drift. Columns are not parallel. This indicates a lack of geometric understanding of document layout.
The paper lacks micro-texture. It looks like a smooth digital gradient rather than physical paper stock, contributing to an uncanny, flat appearance.
The perspective is ambiguous. The top edge seems to curve unnaturally, and the boundary between the menu and the background is soft and bleeding, lacking a sharp cast shadow.
